_about: TODO-30 turn 8 (AB-13), EV-02 under the absolute ambient field (montecarlo ambient-evidence). Legacy recipe (probe mode fov, FieldOfViewStudy): hand-held head, S = 1 m / 5 m, directions 0 / 45 deg, angles 0-20 deg step 0.5, N0 = 500 / 5000 on-axis counts, 100 Poisson repeats per angle, 10^6 photons per mean map, wide non-cyclic decode +-20 deg / 0.3 deg and cyclic one-period decode, success = within one resolution element atan(cell/D), centroid side cue and outside flag (95th percentile of in-field centroid offsets). Here: BSR pedestal replaced by field x t x transported ambient map per bound, t = 10 s / 60 s (activity x t = N0 / on-axis rate in the window), the flag threshold set on 100 separate draws per in-field angle of each series. Window: open only (every deposit — the legacy study counts all detected photons, and it is the worst case: the measured cs662 ambient rate is 1.3 % of the open one at the hand-held head, bare bound). The cs662 window was dropped after the timed pilot (29 min per seed with both windows under a 10-job load; 64 seeds would take ~3 h); see the turn-8 report.
